sites.name: RW Emulator
sites.description: Explore classic console games in your browser
sites.about: RW Emulator is a browser-based retro gaming site for players who want to explore classic console games. Its catalog organizes titles and editions by platform, with game metadata, browser controls, and local save support. Visitors can browse the catalog and play compatible games directly in their browser.
